newsitem.title: UK: BoE's George - Signs of strong stg in retail prices.
newsitem.headline: BoE's George - Signs of strong stg in retail prices.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said on Monday that he saw some signs that the recent strength of sterling was starting to filter through to retail price inflation.
"We have seen some signs, possibly, that it is actually beginning to impact some sectors of retail prices," George told a House of Commens select committee.
George added that given that sterling's climb started in the Autumn of last year, "we ought to be beginning to see the feeding through into the retail sector some of the earlier appreciation".
Sterling has gained around 15 percent on a trade-weighted basis since the summer of last year.
